# Local-only secrets for Firebase Management API + EAS FCM V1.
# Put the Owner SA JSON here (gitignored):
#   secrets/firebase-service-account.json
#
# Or set:
#   export GOOGLE_FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON="/absolute/path/to/key.json"
# Fallback (shared Play+Firebase GCP):
#   export GOOGLE_PLAY_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON=...
#
# Generated by pnpm eas:upload-fcm (never commit):
#   secrets/fcm-expo-push-service-account.json
#
# Required IAM: Owner on GCP project_id.
# EAS upload needs: eas login (session) or EXPO_TOKEN.
# catalog.mjs: EAS_ACCOUNT_NAME = app.json expo.owner (org slug).
